notes_for_editor: Only the Forest Lookouts listing names this tower; Wikipedia confirms the community, not the tower. The 2015-16 Florida chapter report is statewide context and does not name Falmouth. A web search snippet pointed to a 266 ft (81.1 m) state-registered antenna structure at Falmouth built in 1998 (towerdex.com/tower/1061372); towerdex returned HTTP 403, so it was not read and is probably a different structure. Not used. No build, staffing, fate or photo source found.
